name: Oakland International Airport

runway.v: four runways (15/33, 12/30, 10R/28L, 10L/28R); the longest size shown on the FAA diagram is 10,520 ft x 150 ft (about 3,206 m x 46 m)

customs.v: CBP arrival inspections generally 7 days a week, 08:30-15:30; CBP office weekdays 06:00-18:00 and weekends 08:00-16:00 Pacific Time; permission to land must be requested at least 24 hours before arrival; outside these hours contact Westbay Cargo

ppr.v: for international arrivals, CBP permission to land at least 24 hours in advance
ppr.quote: at least 24 hours in advance of the anticipated arrival time

hours.v: airport attended all months, all days, all hours (24 hours)
hours.quote: All Months, All Days, All Hours

noise.v: preferential runway use program 22:00-06:00 (preferred arrival 28L, departures 10R or 28R); a 24-hour noise abatement procedure applies to turbojet and turbofan aircraft (avoid departing 28L/28R or landing 10R/10L); procedures do not apply in emergencies or when runway 12/30 is closed
noise.quote: PREFERENTIAL RWY USE PROGRAM IN EFFECT 2200-0600.

notes: Runway designators and sizes are from the FAA airport diagram AL-294 (6 Aug-3 Sep 2026); the extracted text lists 6213 X 150, 10520 X 150 and 5457 X 150 without tying each to a runway, so only the longest size is recorded; metres are my conversion (1 ft = 0.3048 m). No Port of Oakland noise or night-rules page was found and read, so curfew is not recorded (do not show 'no curfew'). FAA Chart Supplement SW (3 Sep 2026, https://aeronav.faa.gov/Upload_313-d/supplements/CS_SW_20260903.pdf) could not be opened. A CBP KOAK sheet dated 3 Dec 2024 (https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2024-12/KOAK%20GA%20Airport%20Fact%20Sheet%2020241203.pdf) could not be opened; the 20 Nov 2024 sheet was used. 1 Nov 2026: read the FAA US AIP Part 3 AD 2 California page (no edition date shown). Added hours, fuel ('A' read as Jet A) and noise rules from the AIP general remarks. The AIP runway table ties 10520 ft x 150 ft to runway 12/30 (10R/28L 6213 x 150, 10L/28R 5457 x 150, 15/33 3376 x 75; 15/33 closed to air carrier aircraft); the diagram-based runway rule is kept. ARFF Index D. Some taxiways are limited to 12,500 lb. The AIP remarks do not mention a curfew or PPR, so curfew stays missing (do not show 'no curfew').
